title: SpeechR: A Benchmark for Speech Reasoning in Large Audio-Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure aspects of faith or religion. It introduces SpeechR, a benchmark for evaluating three types of reasoning in large audio-language models: factual, procedural, and normative (based on social, ethical, or behavioral norms).
findings: The paper does not analyze or report any findings related to religion or faith.
